pretreatments.description: Physical mechanical preparation of the substrate, including harvesting, air drying, breaking with a paper cutter, sieving (20-40 mesh), vacuum packaging to prevent degradation, and subsequent washing with distilled water before drying.
Hydrothermal pretreatment at 125°C for 30 minutes, followed by cooling to room temperature and subsequent washing with distilled water.
Hydrothermal pretreatment at 150°C for 30 minutes, followed by cooling to room temperature and subsequent washing with distilled water.
Hydrothermal pretreatment at 175°C for 30 minutes, followed by cooling to room temperature and subsequent washing with distilled water.
Hydrothermal pretreatment at 200°C for 30 minutes, followed by cooling to room temperature and subsequent washing with distilled water.
